english.title: Disqualified solicitor fail to disclose struck off / suspended
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a former solicitor whose name has been removed from the roll and with respect to whom a direction is in force under Section 47(2)(g) of the Solicitors Act 1974 prohibiting the restoration of your name to the roll except by order of a Tribunal

(A)_[sought]_
(B)_[accepted]_

employment by a solicitor, namely, **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SOLICITOR..), in connection with that solicitor's practice without previously informing that person of the direction
